name: workNet DuPage Youth Program
what_you_do: Free career help for young adults. It includes one-on-one counseling, resume and interview training, and job placement. You can take job shadows and company tours. You can get paid work at a local worksite. You may get money for training or school.
who_can_apply: Eligible young adults ages 17 to 24. The page does not list other rules or say which counties qualify.
pay_detail: Paid work experience is offered; pay rates and length are not stated. Training or school help is up to $10,000.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Click Apply Now or Get Started at worknetdupage.org/job-seekers/get-started/, or call 630-955-2030. Career Center: 2525 Cabot Drive, Suite 302, Lisle.
notes: Starts at 17, so it fits only older high schoolers. Spanish-speaking services are available. The Get Started page was not read, so check eligibility there.
